clues: The guitar student is exactly 15 years older than the watercolor student.
Jade did not sign up for Spanish.
hints: Look at clues 1, 2 and 3. They all compare ages. Can you line the four students up from youngest to oldest?
Put three clues together. Una is younger than Jade, who is younger than Felix, who is younger than Hugo. Four students, four ages.
So Una is 40, Jade 45, Felix 50 and Hugo 55. Clue 4's 15-year gap then fits only 40 and 55.

solution.key_idea: Clues 1, 2 and 3 chain into one line, Una, Jade, Felix, Hugo, which fixes every age at once.
steps: By clue 3, Una is younger than Jade. By clue 1, Jade is younger than Felix, and by clue 2, Felix is younger than Hugo.
That is a chain of four, so Una is 40, Jade 45, Felix 50 and Hugo 55.
Clue 4 needs a 15-year gap, which fits only 40 and 55. So the watercolor student is 40, and the guitar student is 55.
So Una takes watercolor, and Hugo takes guitar.
By clue 5, Jade is not taking Spanish, so Jade takes pottery, and Felix takes Spanish.
solution.epilogue: Mabel recopied the roll in ink: Una, 40, watercolor; Jade, 45, pottery; Felix, 50, Spanish; Hugo, 55, guitar. Felix offered her a pencil. She declined.
